title: hypothesis.critiqued (v1)
description: CriticAgent has finished critiquing the frozen HypothesisBank against the frozen ResearchSpec and frozen a CritiqueReport into the Research Store (see agents/critic_agent/data-contracts/critique_report.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the report is read from the Research Store by ref.

verdict.description: CriticAgent's overall verdict on the HypothesisBank, mirroring CritiqueReport.verdict.

critique_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen CritiqueReport object.

passing_hypothesis_ids.description: IDs of hypotheses from the HypothesisBank that survived critique. Empty if verdict is all_rejected.
